lines.1: 「Inori overslept and is running late. I flew on ahead without her.」
lines.4: 「Allow me to share some valuable wisdom. Listen well: when thunder comes, it will steal your belly button, so stay inside a mosquito net and chant your sutras.」
lines.5: What century was that bird from...?
lines.6: 「...Whew. I made it just in time.」
lines.7: Only a child would point out that she hadn't.
lines.8: 「Let us begin homeroom. First, attendance. Please tell me if anyone around you is missing.」
